'''Ebyl''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the continent of [[Forethought]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ropagi II]]. The [[Great Library]] was located in the outskirts of the city.<ref name="TSK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>
